Growth Marketing Specialist
Lenskart
Gurugram, Delhi NCR, India (Hybrid)

About Lenskart:
Lenskart is India's omnichannel eyewear pioneer.

Responsibilities:
• Manage performance marketing campaigns across Google, Facebook, and programmatic channels.
• Optimize CAC, LTV, and conversion rate across mobile app and web funnels.
• Partner with product managers on lifecycle marketing, push notifications, and email marketing.

Requirements:
• 2-4 years of experience in performance marketing, growth hacking, or digital marketing.
• Strong analytical capability with SQL, Google Analytics, and attribution platforms.
• Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or engineering.
